method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Age Discrimination Act 2004, Compilation No. 57, compilation date 1 July 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 17, 2025; register id C2026C00266), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A01302.txt; with the Australian Human Rights Commission Act 1986, Compilation No. 58, compilation date 18 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 87, 2026; register id C2026C00416), as deposited at ../../../australian-human-rights-commission-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03366.txt (ss 3(1), 46P, 46PH, 46PO only). No regulations set a number this encoding needs.

scope: From the seat of the older worker (employee or job applicant): ss 5 (age, employment), 6, 10 (reach, as an input), 12(4), 14, 15, 16, 18 (all of (1) and (2), with the domestic duties and inherent requirements exemptions in (3)-(5)), 25, 32, 33, 35, 38, 39(1), (1A), (4), (7), (8), 40, 44 and 47 (a Commission exemption as an input), 47A, 50 (10 penalty units), 51 (6 months); AHRC Act ss 3(1) (unlawful discrimination), 46P (lodging), 46PH(1)(b) (the President may terminate a complaint lodged more than 24 months after the act), 46PO(2) (60 days to apply to court). Can I be made to retire at an age is answered from ss 14 and 18(2)(c). Out: the other areas of Part 4 (ss 19-24, 26-31), the exemptions in ss 34, 36, 37, 41, 41A, 42, 43, Schedules 1 and 2, remedies, conciliation, penalty unit values, the Commission and Commissioner as institutions, and the Fair Work Act general protections (ss 351, 772).
seat: the older worker (the employee or job applicant to whom the Act is applied)
